contact.intro: Write to report a wrong rate, suggest a new tool or ask about advertising.
contact.sentBody: We usually reply in 2-3 working days. If you reported wrong information, the page's "Verified" date changes once it is fixed.

footer.label: Site information
footer.blurb: Bangladesh's money and government-task calculations, in one ledger. An independent guide, not affiliated with any bank or government body.

disclaimer.short: Every calculation and figure on this site is for guidance only.
disclaimer.notAffiliated: Hisab Khata is not affiliated with any bank, mobile financial service or government body. Logos and names are used for information only.
disclaimer.ratesChange: Charges, rates and fees can change at any time. Every number shows its source and the date it was checked.
disclaimer.yourDecision: Before a large transaction, loan or investment, confirm with the institution. We do not give financial advice.
